title: Richard Doty as Air Force counterintelligence

tellings.quote: you know Richard Dodie who was we now

plain: Richard Doty, a man said to have worked in Air Force counterintelligence, the branch that guards against spies, comes up when Jesse Michels starts to explain who Doty turned out to be, though his sentence trails off before he says it. Michels names him alongside two other figures from UFO circles, John Lear and Bill Cooper, and gives no further detail.
